annotations.title: An app's Search & AI To do

description: Use this when the user asks what to do to show up more in Google search or AI answers. One app's organic To do, as Search & AI › To do shows it: one ranked list of the work Google's searches and the AI answers point at, best first, each item in a group (New page: a need no page on the site answers, from Google searches, an AI question, or both; Improve a page: a page Google shows but few click, or just off the top results; Fix what AI says: a wrong claim, or rivals' App Store listings cited instead; Get listed or compared: a rival named instead, or a page the answers cite). Each item has its evidence lines from every source (Google impressions, clicks and position; the AI answers that leave the app out, by engine; the page that ranks now; its visits), its score and why it is first (Google clicks missed at a position a page can reach, plus AI answers weighted by engine, plus a draft waiting), its state (new, planned, drafted, or its guide ready, held, published or dismissed), its finding ids and its actions as the web app offers them. today says how the last morning run went: what it drafted, or why nothing, or the error. unavailable names any part that couldn't be read just now. done lists items marked done with what each brought: Google clicks on its page in the 28 days after against the 28 days before, and AI answers naming the app for its questions, saying where the 28 days aren't in yet.
name: organic_todo
title: An app's Search & AI To do
